title: The Three Dharma Seals
speaker: IkuShun Desiree Webster
summary: The talk explores the concept of the Two Truths in Buddhism, which reveals that our everyday reality is interconnected with a deeper, unconditioned reality. Understanding this interrelation can help us uncover the truth about ourselves and the world around us. By recognizing the impermanence of all things, including our own sense of self, we can begin to let go of attachments and perceptions that cause suffering, ultimately leading to freedom and peace.
